{{Otheruses|Lasan}}
The '''Lasan Suppression''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] victory on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lasan/Legends|Lasan]] at some point prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The Empire's [[Tango Company/Legends|Tango Company]] fought during the battle, earning its members the [[Medal of Valor/Legends|Imperial Medal of Valor]].<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>
